To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the media richness, gratifications, and intimacy are three factors that affect the stickiness of Facebook.
the media richness provided on the Facebook website directly affects users’ gratifications and the intimacy is an essential mediating variable involved in the process of forming SNS stickiness.
the process of formatting the stickiness of Facebook is a process of the media richness of Facebook website, gratification and intimacy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the formation of Facebook Stickness: the Perspectives of media richness theory and intimacy.
the stickiness of social network service, which is a new phenomenon in the era of Web 2.0.
the process of formatting the SNS stickiness and its antecedent variables, and the results provide an empirical foundation to further research on SNS stickiness.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the media richness provided to users by the Facebook website can enhance the users’ gratifications and intimacy, which, in turn, can enhance the users' stickiness.
Facebook stickiness can be explained as a process of the interrelations among the media richness, gratifications, intimacy, and stickiness.
intimacy is an important variable in the process of SNS stickiness formation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Facebook stickiness is the result of the interaction between the media richness of Facebook and the users’ gratifications.
the SNS operators should pay more attention to the richness of the SNS website and the gratification of the SNS users in order to increase the intimacy of users and to retain users on the SNS.
the Facebook stickiness is a result of media richness, which leads to gratifications, and then intimacy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SNS operators can increase users’ stickiness by enhancing their intimacy and providing rich media.
Facebook stickiness is a process of interaction between the SNS and the users.
SNS operators should provide a rich media platform for users, which can satisfy the needs of social interaction and social entertainment.
